SMTO-MEM-0004 — SMTO couldn't search memories with that text

GUID: ea8c456a-93ae-4682-860e-dfa4b9612b9b
Slug: memory-invalid-query
Domain: MEM · Subsystem: mem

What happened

  • The memory search text was empty, too long, or had no words SMTO could search for, so the search didn't run. Your saved memories weren't changed.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. If you asked the agent to look something up in memory, ask again using a few plain keywords, such as a project name or topic. The memory search needs at least one real word and accepts at most 256 characters.
  2. Use words likely to appear in the memory's key or tags, not only punctuation, symbols or a very long pasted passage. This search looks at memory keys and tags, so text without searchable words gives it nothing to look for.
  3. To browse instead, open the Memory Editor and use its search box or the All tags filter. The Memory Editor lists every saved memory, so you can find the one you need without this search.

What success looks like

  • The search returns matching memories, or reports none found, instead of showing this error.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them, with the search text you used, to the person who manages SMTO. Don't resend the same text unchanged; it will fail the same way.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Memory search (MemoryStore.search / RuntimeMemoryStore.search) rejected the query: not a string, blank, longer than 256 characters, containing NUL, or producing no searchable terms.

What this means

  • Memory search rejects non-text, empty/whitespace-only, NUL-containing or longer-than-256-character queries. Memory validation and conditional writes preserve the current stored revision on rejection. This is global Memory, separate from conversation KV; diagnostic rendering does not perform additional storage operations.

Why this can happen

  • Memory search rejects non-text, empty/whitespace-only, NUL-containing or longer-than-256-character queries.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the query's actual text shape before editing stored memories.

How to fix it

  • Pass a nonblank query string of at most 256 characters, without NUL bytes, that yields at least one term from query_terms; this search matches indexed keys and tags, not values. Validation is in search() in src/agent_runtime/skills/memory/store.py and memory_store.py.
  • Supply a bounded supported query and valid filter fields.

Retry and execution caution

  • Apply the correction and confirm the relevant state before requesting another attempt. Prior completed work remains governed by its receipts.

How to verify the fix

  • A supported bounded query searches the intended Memory content.

What not to do

  • Do not repeatedly submit the same invalid input; correct the named constraint first.

Technical notes

  • Memory validation and conditional writes preserve the current stored revision on rejection. This is global Memory, separate from conversation KV; diagnostic rendering does not perform additional storage operations.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
